hints.title: Extracting Letter Multiset Requirement
hints.text: Ignore digits and spaces, converting all letters to lowercase to count the required occurrences of each alphabet character.

hints.title: Comparing Character Frequencies per Candidate
hints.text: For each candidate word, verify that the count of each required letter meets or exceeds the required frequency.

hints.title: Selecting Shortest and First Matching Word
hints.text: Initialize best_word as null. For each word in order, if it contains all required character frequencies and has shorter length than best_word, update best_word.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(L + W * K) time and O(1) auxiliary space bounded by 26 English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incomplete counting fails when a license plate contains duplicate letters like multiple e or s.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed size 26-element integer frequency arrays avoid dynamic allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should maintain tie-breaking by taking the earliest occurrence in the words array for minimum length matches.
